title: Implement Employee API Endpoints with Validation and Standardized Responses
description: Create RESTful API endpoints for employees under `/app/api/employees` using Next.js route handlers, applying validation and standardized response utilities.
details: Create `app/api/employees/route.ts` for list and create operations, and `app/api/employees/[employeeId]/route.ts` for detail, update, and delete operations. Use the Zod schemas for input validation and the standardized response/error utilities for all responses. Include authentication checks at the start of each handler (using existing session logic). Use placeholder data as per project constraints.
test_strategy: Write integration tests for each endpoint to verify correct behavior: successful requests, validation failures, unauthorized access, and error handling. Confirm response format and status codes are consistent.

title: Refactor Employee Dashboard Page to Use API Endpoints
description: Update the employee dashboard page to fetch data from the new API endpoints using TanStack Query.
details: Modify `app/dashboard/employee/page.tsx` to replace static/placeholder data with client-side data fetching from `/api/employees` using TanStack Query's `useQuery` hook. Handle loading, error, and success states according to the standardized API response format. Ensure UI updates correctly based on API data.
test_strategy: Manually test the page to verify it loads employee data from the API, displays loading and error states, and updates when data changes. Write component tests if possible to cover these states.

title: Document API Route Structure and Usage
description: Add documentation describing the API route structure, response format, validation approach, and usage examples for developers.
details: Create or update a markdown file (e.g., `docs/api-routes.md`) to explain the `/app/api` directory structure, available endpoints, standardized response format, error handling conventions, and how to consume the endpoints from frontend components. Include code snippets and best practices.
test_strategy: Review documentation for completeness and clarity. Have another developer follow the documentation to implement a simple API consumer as a test.

title: Create Standardized API Response and Error Handling Utilities
description: Develop reusable utilities in the `lib/` directory to standardize API responses and error handling for all API routes.
details: Implement a utility module (e.g., `lib/api-helpers.ts`) that exports functions for sending standardized JSON responses (e.g., `{ data: T | null, error: string | null }`) and handling errors with appropriate HTTP status codes. Include helpers for common error types (validation, authentication, not found, server errors). Ensure all API routes can import and use these utilities for consistency.
test_strategy: Write unit tests for each utility function to verify correct response formatting and error handling. Test with various input scenarios (success, validation error, unauthorized, not found, server error).

title: Define Zod Validation Schemas for Employee API
description: Create Zod schemas to validate request bodies and parameters for the employee API endpoints.
details: In `lib/validations/employee.ts`, define Zod schemas for employee data structures (e.g., create, update, and query operations). Ensure schemas cover all required fields and constraints. Export these schemas for use in API route handlers to validate incoming requests.
test_strategy: Write unit tests for each schema to ensure valid data passes and invalid data is correctly rejected. Test edge cases and missing/extra fields.
